summary: Interpreted the persistence accounting probe. Receipt a3ffa023758942a68c7430d311df52b0 passed with one event: entriesToSave was empty after indexes 1-4 were acknowledged as saved, and after a conflicting term-2 append at index 3 it began at index 3 with length two while the log ended at index 4 term 2. That is the predicted lowering of the saved index, so replaced entries are re-reported as unsaved and no truncated entry stays classified as durable. Marked the investigation explained with defect_claim refuted, promoted the observed range to knowledge, and kept the in-memory-only scope and single conflict position as limits.
